title: NHK — 大相撲：国技の世界 (Grand Sumo: Japan's National Sport)
description: NHK documentary on the world of grand sumo (大相撲). Covers the history of sumo as a Shinto ritual, stable life (部屋), the ranking system (番付) from jonokuchi to yokozuna, tournament structure (本場所), and key techniques (決まり手). Features interviews with wrestlers and coaches in natural spoken Japanese.
creator: NHK
